footer_text: Gemaoyy - Your fitness website to track your goals
home_subtitle: Sign up on Gemaoyy and calculate your daily needs of calories, protein, carbs and fat. You can also check the calories of any food easily.
feature1_desc: Enter your weight, height, age, activity level and goal (cutting / maintenance / bulking) and we'll calculate the calories, protein, carbs and fat you need every day.
feature2_desc: Pick a food and enter the amount in grams, and we'll show you its calories, protein, carbs and fat in detail.
feature3_desc: Create an account and all your data and results stay saved so you can come back to them anytime.
feature4_desc: Enter your chest, waist, hip and thigh measurements and get an estimated body fat percentage and a visual preview of your body shape.
err_password_short: Password must be at least 6 characters

dash_no_data_title: You haven't calculated your daily needs yet
dash_no_data_desc: Enter your weight, height, age, activity level and goal so we can calculate the calories, protein, carbs and fat you need.
dash_foods_desc: Find the calories of any food by choosing it and entering the amount in grams.
cal_subtitle: Enter your data and we'll calculate your daily needs of calories, protein, carbs and fat.
opt_very_active: Very intense activity (athlete / high physical effort)
err_fill_correct: Please fill in all fields correctly
phase1_desc: Start with these calories to lose weight fast and get an early visual boost, but don't stay on this for too long - it can affect your muscle and hormones.
phase2_desc: After the first 2-3 weeks, switch to these calories and stay on them until you reach your goal - a moderate deficit you can sustain without losing much muscle.
recomp_desc: Here the goal is to lose fat while keeping (or slightly building) muscle at the same time. A small deficit with very high protein and consistent resistance training is the key.
foods_subtitle: Choose a food and enter the amount in grams to know its calories, protein, carbs and fat.
err_food_not_found: This food was not found in the database
bodyshape_subtitle: Enter your body measurements to get an estimated body fat percentage and a visual preview of your body shape.
bodyshape_protein_hint: Protein is calculated as 2.2g per kg of lean body mass to maintain and build it.
bodyshape_disclaimer: This is just a rough estimate, not a medical measurement.
dash_bodyshape_desc: Enter your measurements to estimate your body fat percentage and preview your body shape.
ex_subtitle: Ready-made workout splits, and every major muscle group with its exercises and alternatives at the gym or home, plus tips for bulking and cutting.
ex_splits_subtitle: Choose the split that fits how many days a week you train.
ex_muscles_subtitle: Each major muscle with its main exercises and alternatives, and whether it's better for bulking or cutting.
ex_cardio_subtitle: To burn calories and improve heart and lung fitness.
ex_home_subtitle: Bodyweight or simple-equipment exercises if you don't have a gym.
